sentences.en: Hi, Hannah. What are you up to?
sentences.zh: 嗨，汉娜。你在忙什么？

sentences.en: Hey, Mike. Nothing much. I’m at home.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克。没什么。我在家呢。

sentences.en: I’m watching some TV, but it’s not very good.
sentences.zh: 我在看会儿电视，不过节目不太好。

sentences.en: I don’t want to do my homework!
sentences.zh: 我不想做作业！

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I’m in town. Shopping.
sentences.zh: 我在城里。逛街呢。

sentences.en: I’m looking for a new jacket. Do you like this one? It’s £20.
sentences.zh: 我在找一件新夹克。你喜欢这件吗？20 英镑。

sentences.en: Erm. It’s OK. It looks a bit old-fashioned though.
sentences.zh: 呃。还行吧。不过看起来有点过时。

sentences.en: Which shop are you in?
sentences.zh: 你在哪家店？

sentences.en: Tell me you’re not looking for clothes in that old place in Green Street.
sentences.zh: 别告诉我说你在格林街那个老地方买衣服。

sentences.en: Hah! Of course I am!
sentences.zh: 哈！我还真就在那儿！

sentences.en: You know I always like to buy my clothes here.
sentences.zh: 你知道我一直喜欢在这里买衣服。

sentences.en: But their clothes are all second-hand.
sentences.zh: 可他们的衣服都是二手的。

sentences.en: And that means they’re old-fashioned.
sentences.zh: 那就意味着款式很旧。

sentences.en: I like the clothes here – they’re really cool and they’re cheap.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这里的衣服——真的很酷，而且很便宜。

sentences.en: I’m not rich like you, you know!
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可不像你那么有钱！

sentences.en: Me? Rich? You’re joking of course. Hahaha.
sentences.zh: 我？有钱？你开玩笑吧。哈哈哈。

sentences.en: Go to Barker’s next to the big chemist’s in Market Street.
sentences.zh: 去市场街那家大药房旁边的巴克店吧。

sentences.en: They’ve got a sale on.
sentences.zh: 他们正在打折。

sentences.en: They’re selling everything at 30% off the original price!
sentences.zh: 所有东西都比原价便宜 30%！

sentences.en: And their stuff’s really nice.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的东西真的很好。

sentences.en: I’m wearing one of their T-shirts now. Only £9.99!
sentences.zh: 我现在穿着他们的一件 T 恤。只要 9.99 英镑！

sentences.en: Yeah, that’s cool. And 30% off? Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 是吗，那很酷。还能便宜 30%？太棒了。

sentences.en: OK, I’m going there now. Oh no!
sentences.zh: 好，我现在就去。哎呀！

sentences.en: Now it’s raining and I haven’t got an umbrella.
sentences.zh: 现在下雨了，我还没带伞。

sentences.en: OK, it’s not far. Five minutes and I’m there.
sentences.zh: 没关系，不远。五分钟就到。

sentences.en: Moments later.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后。

sentences.en: OK, here I am in Barker’s.
sentences.zh: 好，我到巴克店了。

sentences.en: The shop’s really crowded. It’s because of the sale, I guess.
sentences.zh: 店里真挤。我想是因为打折吧。

sentences.en: Maybe my mum’s there. She’s doing some shopping at the moment.
sentences.zh: 也许我妈妈在那儿。她这会儿正在购物。

sentences.en: So … anything nice?
sentences.zh: 那么……有什么好看的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah! Look at this shirt! Only £25! I want it!
sentences.zh: 是啊！你看这件衬衫！只要 25 英镑！我要买。

sentences.en: Mike, are you crazy? It’s awful.
sentences.zh: 迈克，你疯了吗？太难看了。

sentences.en: No, it’s not.
sentences.zh: 不，不难看。

sentences.en: I love wearing bright colours.
sentences.zh: 我就喜欢穿亮色的衣服。

sentences.en: They make me feel happy. It’s perfect for a rainy day.
sentences.zh: 它们让我开心。雨天穿正合适。

sentences.en: I think you’re wasting your money and my time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你在浪费钱，也在浪费我的时间。

sentences.en: Anyway – are you looking for a jacket or a shirt?
sentences.zh: 话说回来——你到底是在找夹克还是衬衫？

sentences.en: Oh yes, you’re right. You’re better at clothes than me.
sentences.zh: 哦对，你说得对。你比我更懂衣服。

sentences.en: Come and help me. You’re not doing anything, are you?
sentences.zh: 来帮帮我吧。反正你现在也没事，对吧？

sentences.en: That sounds like a bad idea. It’s raining – remember?
sentences.zh: 那听起来可不是个好主意。还在下雨呢——记得吗？
